name: Conveyor systems
lead: Design and installation of stainless steel conveyor systems for food and drink production.
body: Marpet designs, manufactures and installs conveyor systems, in the workshop or on site at client premises.
The photographs below are Marpet conveyors from the existing website: modular belt conveyors, roller conveyors, inclined sections and pin conveyor lines.

name: Production lines
lead: Bespoke production line fabrications, designed and supplied by Marpet.
body: Production line work brings conveyors, work stations, tables and guarding together into one line.

name: Industrial pipework
lead: Stainless steel pipework fabrication for food and drink processing.
body: Marpet designs and supplies bespoke pipework fabrications, installed on site.

name: Access platforms
lead: Bespoke stainless steel access platforms, stairs and handrails.
body: Marpet designs and supplies bespoke access platform fabrications for production areas.

name: Catering fabrication
lead: Stainless fabrication for cafes, bars, clubs and restaurants, to your design or ours.
body: Marpet's catering division provides cafes, bars, clubs and restaurants with stainless fabrication, in standard and bespoke sizes.

name: Dentistry equipment
lead: A range of dentistry equipment, fabricated to your design or ours.
body: Marpet produces a range of dentistry equipment in standard and bespoke sizes.

name: General fabrication
lead: Stainless steel, mild steel and aluminium fabrication, designed, manufactured and installed.
body: Marpet will design, manufacture and install on site virtually all types of stainless steel, mild steel or aluminium fabrication.
